# Data sources

<!-- Generated by `uv run --project functions mdp sources doc`. Edit the function declarations or docs/sources/annotations.csv, then regenerate; never edit this file. -->

Sources collected, derived, imported or planned. Facts come from function declarations, `streamline_defaults` and [`dbt/seeds/rights_registry.csv`](../dbt/seeds/rights_registry.csv). Assessments come from [`docs/sources/annotations.csv`](sources/annotations.csv). Planned rows are recorded in the same annotations file.

Public charts and catalogs, platform playlists, and derived tables have distinct access and refresh schedules. The registry records each source’s usage permissions.

- **Status**: `built` and `built, off` are the switch a new streamline starts with in code; operators flip the live switch in the console. `fixtures only` lands checked-in fixtures. `registry only` has a rights row and no function. `retired` keeps its streamline and landed rows, disabled.
- **Method**: `(scraped)` marks a public page or embed read with ordinary HTTP and an honest user agent. SoundCloud live access requires an official, credentialed integration; the included readers are offline fixtures only.
- **Proxy**: `no` fetches direct from Fly; `—` makes no outside request.
- **Refresh**: the declared cadence. `+ weekly twin` means a `<key>_weekly` key shares the row and fetches weekly members in weekday buckets; `tenant` means tenant-bound; a budget is the time after which a gold run stops and ends partial.
- **Speed & breadth**: measured from recorded runs, else `not measured`; `plan:` is a planned size, not a measurement.
- **Rights**: learning eligible / resale permitted, then the licence reference. Rights annotate rows and never gate them.

## Summary

- **Rows**: 32; a `_weekly` twin shares its daily key's row.
- **Status**: built 9 · fixtures only 3 · built, off 16 · registry only 2 · retired 2.
- **Category**: public charts and catalogs 22 · platform playlists 10.
- **Method**: official API 12 · vendor API 2 · public page 9 · public embed/JSON 5 · dump/mirror 3 · platform seed 1.
- **Scraped**: 14 rows read a public page or embed; 12 of them are built.
- **Proxy**: 0 rows declare the residential tier. It exists for targets whose market changes the response, and an operator knob can force it per streamline.

## Notes

- `am_playlist`, `am_playlist_weekly`: Full lists up to 300 tracks with song, album and artist ids; Apple shows no follower counts or add times.
- `sp_playlist`, `sp_playlist_weekly`: The embed carries rows 1-100 and the page adds followers and play counts for rows 1-30. No public Spotify surface carries an ISRC, so tracks resolve through MusicBrainz and the crosswalk.
- `wiki_pageviews`: Human views (agent=user) per article, each published day is stored (0 where it lists none); the mart sums them across the act's top 10 editions per act and day. A 600 s budget reads 120 acts at 10 articles, largest editions first; past it the run ends partial.
- `sc_curator_playlists`, `sc_playlist`, `sc_hubs`: Offline fixtures only. Live collection requires an official, credentialed API integration, which is not included. Web application credentials are not supported.
- `bc_daily_list`, `bc_discover`, `bc_fan_playlist`, `bc_radio`, `bc_tralbum`: Disabled by default.
- `kexp_plays`: Ships disabled. Rows stay operator-only and learning false until the registry row's `review_ref` names KEXP's written permission.
- `lb_fresh_releases`: Ships disabled; commercial use needs a MetaBrainz supporter subscription. Tags (CC BY-NC-SA) are dropped at the parser.
- `lb_popularity`: Ships disabled; commercial use needs a MetaBrainz supporter subscription. Act grain from the spine; SQL computes daily rates from changes between observations.
- `lb_sitewide`: Ships disabled; commercial use needs a MetaBrainz supporter subscription. last_updated tells whether the upstream statistics run refreshed that week.
- `sp_playlist_embed`, `sp_playlist_page`: Replaced by the paired `sp_playlist`; landed rows keep their streamline.
- `apple_song_duration`: US storefront only. Disabled until a small global track set is active. Unknown permissions grant no learning or resale. See [duration collection](../functions/CLAUDE.md#apple-song-durations) to enable.
- `jev_instrument_family`: Disabled; fixture responses are synthetic.
- `lb_similar_artists`: Ships disabled; commercial use needs a MetaBrainz supporter subscription; learning stays false until MetaBrainz confirms Labs outputs are CC0. Looked up once a week under the seeded algorithm, inside the daily global job: the input carries the cycle's ISO week. Names, types, genders and comments never land.
- `typesafe`: Provider budget and terms need an account holder to configure access.
- `sp_track_artists`: Reads tracks no playlist row identifies by artist id, once per id; a failing track retries each day.
- `wiki_sitelinks`: Looked up once a week inside the daily global job: the input carries the cycle's ISO week. QIDs come from the MusicBrainz spine's Wikidata links.
- `mb_artist_catalog`: Declared `enabled=False` like the other mirror functions; turn it on with the `enabled` knob once `MDP_MB_DB_URL` is set. Looked up once a week inside the daily job: the input carries the cycle's ISO week. Lands release groups by kind and the first dated release from the CC0 core tables; SQL sets the stage from `dbt/seeds/artist_stage_thresholds.csv`.
- `mb_spine`: The closure also reaches every label an artist has an affiliation with, up to its root owner, with IPI and ISNI codes and Wikidata and social links, at the next import.
- `track_isrc_crosswalk`: Deezer's terms say non-commercial, so learning and resale stay false pending a permissions review.
- `jev_instruments`: Expected labels are authored locally and never sent to the vendor.
